en: the biggest religion in the world.

text:
그것은 자신을 다른 사람들과
늘 비교하며
en: It always compares itself with others

text:
다른 사람들보다 낫다는 걸
알아차리면 *안정*을 누려요"
en: and feels secure when it finds it's better than them."
So what do people do when they get together?
When pastors get together, associate pastors,
they all badmouth the senior pastor.
And your get-togethers? You all badmouth the boss.

text:
뭐 그런 부분도
있어야 된다고 생각합니다
en: I think we need a bit of that,

text:
그래서 늘 저는 어느 모임에서
처음부터 끝까지 안 있어요
en: So I never stay at a gathering from start to finish.
I think I should step out for a while,

text:
그래야지 좀 마음 편하게
얘기하고 뭐 욕도 좀 하고 하죠
en: so people can talk freely, even vent a little.
This is the biggest religion in the world.
